title: First music he remembered: Bessie Smith records and guitar blues players
summary: He remembers gramophone records of Bessie Smith and Ma Rainey and weekend guitar blues players from the turpentine fields.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Where the blues came from: Handy, Bolden and early blues

blocks.x: Do you remember the first music you heard in Savannah and what music it was?
Well, you mean in person, or a record, or what?
What is the first music you remember?

Gramophone -- it was -- I'm pretty sure it was Bessie Smith, one of the first ones. Of course, I heard Ma Rainey too, but I think Bessie Smith was about the first one that I heard. But I heard a lot of music in person from the -- these old guitar players because they'd drink a lot, you know, and come in and sing the blues and play these guitars. They'd do that all the whole weekend. Then they'd
The ones that worked in the turpentine--
Then they'd go back to the turpentine fields.
Do you remember the names of any of them?
No, I don't remember any -- none of them got to be very popular, real popular. But they were good.
